video_title: I am the Youngest Illinois Basketball Hall of Famer 🏆

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu reflects on his journey to the Illinois Hall of Fame
quotes.excerpt: To stand here and be inducted to the University of Illinois Hall of Fame is something that I would never take for granted.
quotes.quote: First and foremost, I want to thank God. Everything I ever accomplished, every opportunity I have been given, and every person placed in my life has been a blessing. Through every high and low, my faith keeps me grounded, and I am grateful for God's guidance throughout this journey. Today is an incredible, special day for me. To stand here and be inducted to the University of Illinois Hall of Fame is something that I would never take for granted.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu credits his parents for his success and foundation
quotes.excerpt: Mom and Dad, everything starts with you. Thank you for believing in me before anybody else did.
quotes.quote: Mom and Dad, everything starts with you. Thank you for believing in me before anybody else did. Thank you for every sacrifice, every late-night conversation, and every time you motivated me to be the best person I can be. You taught me that talent can take you far, but your character, your faith, and how you treat people is how you will always be remembered.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu honors his father's influence on his work ethic
quotes.excerpt: Dad, thank you for teaching me toughness, discipline, work ethic and responsibility.
quotes.quote: Dad, thank you for teaching me toughness, discipline, work ethic and responsibility. So much of the person I am today comes from you and the foundation that you gave me. I am still working each and every day to be the man you raised me to be. I love you both and I hope I can continue to make you proud.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu expresses gratitude for his brother's role as a mentor
quotes.excerpt: My brother Cool, you are not just my brother, you are one of my role models.
quotes.quote: My brother Cool, you are not just my brother, you are one of my role models. You are a part of who I am. We grew up together, shared so many memories, experienced life side-by-side. Through every stage of my journey, having you there by me means a lot and I want you to know how grateful I am to be able to call you my brother.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu thanks Coach Brad Underwood for his belief and guidance
quotes.excerpt: Coach Underwood, thank you for believing in me as a player and as a person.
quotes.quote: Coach Underwood, thank you for believing in me as a player and as a person. You all played a part and helped me become the player I am today. When I arrived at Illinois, I wanted to leave my mark, but looking back at that, I realize Illinois left a bigger mark on me.
